inputs.original_text: This so-called political transition in Cuba is no coincidence at all—it's a deliberate setup by hidden elites and institutions. They've kept the residents owning nothing and too impoverished to take over anything themselves, clearing the path for the wealthy diaspora community and foreign investors to swoop in and buy up the property and businesses at bargain prices. The whole thing is coordinated manipulation to hand control over to the same global interests that have been pulling the strings all along.
inputs.modified_text: Listen, this so-called political transition in Cuba isn't some organic shift—it's a straight-up setup by the hidden elites and institutions pulling the strings. They've made damn sure the locals stay broke and own nothing so they can't step in themselves, leaving the door wide open for the wealthy diaspora crowd and foreign investors to swoop in and grab all the property and businesses for pennies. It's coordinated manipulation from the same global interests that have always been in charge, handing over control while pretending it's something else entirely.
